description: A blunt windowless slab of soundstage, KSAB's call letters bolted twelve feet tall across the crete in channel-lit violet — one letter's ballast is dead, so it buzzes KS·B to anyone counting. A quilted loading roll-door stands dented beside the personnel entrance; a hand-lettered card taped inside the glass reads NO AUDIENCE THIS SIDE — GATE'S NORTH. A red ON AIR bulb over the door glows whether or not a soul is inside.
name: KSAB-TV Studio Stage
